<thought>The base peak at m/z 114.06808 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ~113.0608 Da. A formula that matches this mass within a few ppm is C₆H₉O₂ (exact mass 113.060255 Da; [M+H]⁺ = 114.067531 Da, ~5 ppm from the observed value). No other heteroatoms are required.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
